issues.description: The agent answers a direct information-sale concern with <ref job="SRJ_umoRy7ka2myJ" item="item_893c1340-43e">a vendor privacy-policy referral and unverified opt-out claims</ref>, rather than resolving what it can confirm about the lender’s handling of the caller’s data. Observed once.
issues.suggestion: Use approved, lender-specific privacy wording; distinguish verified practices from unknowns and offer an appropriate privacy contact instead of implying the vendor policy answers for the lender.
issues.label: Privacy response

issues.description: Conventional refinance explanations make categorical claims about <ref job="SRJ_sqq5zTfvKsgf" item="item_4f080e98-3ba">upfront fees, mortgage insurance, and loan limits</ref>; a second caller received <ref job="SRJ_fXqxvnwLmBEm" item="item_233ed0b7-857">the same unqualified fee and insurance claims</ref>. These can misstate costs or requirements for a specific loan.
issues.suggestion: Replace blanket product-benefit templates with qualified, institution-neutral explanations and defer loan-specific fees, insurance and limits to the eligibility review or licensed officer.
issues.label: Product accuracy

issues.description: Discovery sometimes ignores goals already supplied: a caller <ref job="SRJ_sqq5zTfvKsgf" item="item_4f738735-4e6">stated both refinance and lake-house plans</ref>, yet the agent <ref job="SRJ_sqq5zTfvKsgf" item="item_00f5e19f-b31">asked for the basic intent again</ref>; another <ref job="SRJ_MtVK4e56tJfz" item="item_9d8adee4-3f4">explicitly wanted a lower payment</ref> and was later <ref job="SRJ_MtVK4e56tJfz" item="item_12b6bd00-576">asked to choose that goal again</ref>.
issues.suggestion: Persist opening-turn goals and facts as filled discovery slots, then condition each scripted question on what remains unknown; for multiple goals, ask which to address first.
issues.label: Goal retention
